description_en: Queries the details of one or more route maps
description_zh: 查询一个或多个路由策略的详细信息
name: ListRouteMaps

parameters.help_en:
The client token that is used to ensure the idempotence of the request.

You can generate a value for this parameter on your client to ensure that the value is unique across different requests. The client token can contain only ASCII characters.

If you do not specify this parameter, the system automatically uses the RequestId of the API request as the client token. The RequestId of each API request may be different
parameters.help_zh:
客户端Token，用于保证请求的幂等性。

从您的客户端生成一个参数值，确保不同请求间该参数值唯一。ClientToken只支持ASCII字符。

若您未指定，则系统自动使用API请求的RequestId作为ClientToken标识。每次API请求的RequestId可能不一样
parameters.name: client_token

parameters.help_en: The IDs of the route maps to query. If you do not specify this parameter, all route maps are queried
parameters.help_zh: 要查询的路由策略ID列表。不提供则查询所有
parameters.name: route_map_ids

fields.help_en:
The filter condition. Valid values:

Direction: the direction of the route map.
Name: the name of the route map.
Priority: the priority of the route map.

By default, multiple filter conditions are connected by an AND logical operator. A route map must meet all filter conditions to be considered a match.

You can specify up to 5 filter conditions at a time
fields.help_zh:
过滤条件。取值：

Direction：路由策略的方向。
Name：路由策略的名称。
Priority：路由策略的优先级。

多个过滤条件之间默认是与的关系，即必须符合所有过滤条件，才视为匹配过滤条件。

一次最多支持输入5个过滤条件
fields.name: key

fields.help_en:
The value of the filter condition.

Specify the filter value based on the Key. You can specify multiple filter values for a single Key. Multiple filter values are connected by an OR logical operator. A route map that meets any of the filter values is considered a match for the filter condition.

You can specify up to 5 filter values for a single filter condition
fields.help_zh:
过滤条件的值。

根据Key指定过滤值。一个Key支持指定多个过滤值，多个过滤值之间是或的关系，即只要符合其中一个过滤值，则视为匹配该过滤条件。

一个过滤条件最多支持输入5个过滤值
fields.name: value

parameters.help_en:
The filter conditions.

You can specify up to 5 filter conditions at a time
parameters.help_zh:
过滤条件的信息。

一次最多支持输入5个过滤条件
parameters.name: filter

parameters.help_en: The ID of the resource group
parameters.name: resource_group_id

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to only precheck the request. Valid values:

true: sends a check request without performing the query. The system checks whether required parameters are specified, the request format, and service limits. If the check fails, the corresponding error is returned. If the check succeeds, the error code `DryRunOperation` is returned.
false (default): sends a normal request
parameters.help_zh:
是否只预检此次请求。取值：

true：发送检查请求，不会执行查询。检查项包括是否填写了必需参数、请求格式、业务限制等。如果检查不通过，则返回对应错误。如果检查通过，则返回错误码`DryRunOperation`。
false（默认值）：发送正常请求
parameters.name: dry_run

parameters.help_en:
The number of entries to return on each page. Valid values: 1 to 100.
If you do not specify the MaxResults parameter, pagination is not used. After you call the operation, the value of MaxResults indicates the total number of entries. If you specify the MaxResults parameter, pagination is used. After you call the operation, the value of MaxResults indicates the number of entries on the current page. We recommend that you set MaxResults to 20
parameters.help_zh:
分批次查询时每次显示的条目数。取值范围：1~100。
如果您不指定MaxResults参数的值，则表示您不需要分批次查询。调用接口后MaxResults的值表示列表条目总数。如果您指定MaxResults参数的值，则表示您需要分批次查询。调用接口后MaxResults的值表示当前查询批次下列表条目的数量。建议指定MaxResults参数的值为20
parameters.name: max_results

parameters.help_en:
The token for the next query. Valid values:

If this is the first query or no next query is available, you do not need to specify this parameter.
If a next query is available, set the value to the NextToken value returned from the previous API call
parameters.help_zh:
是否拥有下一次查询的令牌（Token）。取值：

第一次查询和没有下一次查询时，均无需填写。
如果有下一次查询，取值为上一次API调用返回的NextToken值
parameters.name: next_token

schema.description_en:
The time when the route map was created.

The time follows the ISO 8601 standard in the `YYYY-MM-DDThh:mm:ssZ` format. The time is displayed in UTC
schema.description_zh:
创建路由策略的时间。

时间按照ISO8601标准表示，并使用UTC时间。格式为：`YYYY-MM-DDThh:mm:ssZ`

MaxResults.description_en: The number of entries returned on each page. Default value: 20
MaxResults.description_zh: 分批次查询时，每次显示的条目数。默认值为20

NextToken.description_en:
The token for the next query. Valid values:

If NextToken is empty, no next query is available.
If NextToken returns a value, the value is the token for the next query
NextToken.description_zh:
是否拥有下一次查询的令牌（Token）。取值：

如果NextToken为空表示没有下一次查询。
如果NextToken有返回值，该取值表示下一次查询开始的令牌

RouteMaps.description_en: The information about the route maps

items.description_en: The information about the route maps

CreationTime.description_en:
The time when the route map was created.

The time follows the ISO 8601 standard in the `YYYY-MM-DDThh:mmZ` format. The time is displayed in UTC
CreationTime.description_zh:
创建路由策略的时间。

时间按照ISO8601标准表示，并使用UTC时间。格式为：`YYYY-MM-DDThh:mmZ`

Description.description_en: The description of the route map

Direction.description_en:
The direction of the route map. Valid values: 
Inbound: inbound.
Outbound: outbound
Direction.description_zh:
路由策略的方向。取值如下： 
Inbound：入方向。
Outbound：出方向

Name.description_en: The name of the route map

Priority.description_en: The priority of the route map. A smaller value indicates a higher priority
Priority.description_zh: 路由策略的优先级。优先级数字越小，代表优先级越高

ResourceGroupId.description_en: The ID of the resource group

RouteMapId.description_en: The ID of the route map

Status.description_en:
The status of the route map. Valid values:

Creating: The route map is being created.
Updating: The route map is being updated.
Active: The route map is available.
Deleting: The route map is being deleted
Status.description_zh:
路由策略的状态。取值：

Creating：创建中。
Updating：更新中。
Active：可用。
Deleting：删除中

Version.description_en:
The version number of the route map configuration.
The version number increases each time the route map and its associated route map rules are modified
Version.description_zh:
路由策略配置版本号。
每次针对路由策略及相关路由策略规则变更后，版本号都会增长
